successor_relationship.disclosure: Designed AFTER native outcomes were known and recorded (TP 137/272 K562-obs, 41/128 RPE1-obs; both partial-interventional cells empty). This is a VALIDITY control on the native chain, not decisive evidence for any paper claim. No parent frozen endpoint is modified.

permutation.object: interventions vector (per-sample perturbed-gene labels), shuffled across ALL samples
permutation.preserved: label marginal (count of each label value), expression_matrix bytes, var_names
permutation.raw_data_policy: raw npz files are NEVER modified; permuted copies written to campaign-e40-perm-r1/data/<dataset>_perm<seed>.npz

design.invocation: identical to e40_compute_native_r3.sbatch main_app call, differing ONLY in --data_directory (perm copy) and --exp_id (500000 + cell*3 + seed_idx)

pre_declared_interpretation.VALIDITY_PASS: in each observational cell, median TP over seeds 1-3 is < 50% of the native TP (137 K562, 41 RPE1): the native chain is signal-sensitive, its observational metrics are not produced by pipeline artifacts
pre_declared_interpretation.VALIDITY_FAIL: median permuted TP >= 50% of native TP in any observational cell: native chain validity defect; native characterization interpretation reopens
pre_declared_interpretation.AMBIGUOUS_EMPTY: partial-interventional cells that were empty natively and remain empty under permutation are recorded as AMBIGUOUS_EMPTY (cannot distinguish signal absence from pipeline failure) and are NOT interpreted as pass or fail
